title: The Faded Painting
scene: At 3:20 PM, the studio painting was splashed with thinner. The studio lights tripped off from 3:10 to 3:35.

suspects.name: Celia Wren
suspects.testimony: I was sketching by the window at 3:20 while the lights were out.
suspects.alibiProof: Celia's sketch has a pencil date at 3:19 and daylight shading.

suspects.name: Nolan Fenn
suspects.testimony: I was measuring frames in the back room at 3:20.
suspects.alibiProof: The saw bench camera shows Nolan cutting at 3:18 and 3:23.

suspects.name: Yara Cole
suspects.testimony: I was cleaning brushes at the sink from 3:15 to 3:30.
suspects.alibiProof: The sink log shows Yara's badge at 3:16 and running water until 3:29.

suspects.name: Bruno Hale
suspects.testimony: I was in the cafe downstairs at 3:20, waiting for the lights.
suspects.contradiction: The cafe stayed closed until 3:40, and thinner drips trail from Bruno's shoes.
